newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P places Korea First Bank on credit watch.
newsitem.headline: S&P places Korea First Bank on credit watch.

text.p: Standard & Poor's (S&P) said on Wednesday it had placed its BBB+/A-2 counterparty and certificate of deposit (CD) rating and A-2 commercial paper ratings of Korea First Bank on CreditWatch with negative implications.

S&P said the action reflected its concern over the deterioration of Korea First Bank's asset quality resulting from its large exposure to Hanbo Steel Co, a major customer of the bank that filed for bankruptcy last week.
Korea First Bank is the largest creditor among the consortium of banks that extended to the steelmaker credits totalling nearly five trillion won (about $5.8 billion), S&P said.
Future rating actions would be determined by the bankruptcy proceedings and their impact on the financial parameters of the bank, it said.
